slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Flying for Christmas? Bags packed, but is your back ready? ✈️

You can lift a bag five or six times per trip. Spinner cases with four wheels roll beside you, so you push rather than drag with a twisted arm. Swap hands every so often.

At the carousel, wait until your bag comes close, step in, bend your knees and pull it towards you before lifting. For the overhead locker, lift your carry-on to the armrest first, then up, facing the locker. Pack heavy items at the wheel end.

Back pain that spreads down a leg, comes with numbness or weakness, or isn't easing a few days after you get home is worth assessing. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
